messages:
olivia: PartnerTech reported instability on their on-prem racks when running ROCm 6.4 + kernel 6.1. Symptoms: intermittent driver hangs and failed kernels during long attention runs (~10k tokens). Need to align on pinning + a hotfix delivery lane.

diego: noted. do we know if it's ROCm or a kernel ABI issue? partner supplied dmesg + rocm logs in ticket PT-449.

partner-ops: logs attached. failures show HSA_QUEUE_PACKET errors and occasional GPU resets. Happens on MI250x and MI300 nodes. OS: RHEL 8.9, kernel 6.1.12, rocm 6.4.0, rock-dkms 5.23.

rachel: suggestion: publish a marketplace/private-pack image pinned to ROCm 6.3 + rock-dkms 5.21 as "stable-amd". label 6.4 as "beta-amd" and gate with CI regression tests.

olivia: agree. also want a short canary plan for SI partners who already upgraded. propose: canary 0.5% traffic, validate 24h of long-context jobs, monitor `rocm_error_count` and `gpu_reset_rate`. rollback threshold: >0.005 resets/min sustained for 15m.

qa-bot: preflight job created: CI-PT-ROCm-LONGCTX. runs a 10k-token end-to-end on MI250x image; fail if any HSA errors or >1 reset.

diego: automation: lambda to re-tag instances to `stable-amd` and notify partner channel. who owns wiring?

rachel: eng-oncall + partner-ops. i'll draft marketplace docs with toggle snippet: 

```yaml
image: redwood/inference:amd-marketplace-2026-03
rocm_pin: 6.3.0
rock_dkms_pin: 5.21
channel: stable-amd # beta-amd available for testing
```

olivia: partner comms: PartnerTech prefers a joint KB and advisory. will coordinate copy with their PM. keep messaging: "we recommend pinning to 6.3 for production; 6.4 beta available for evaluation".

eng-oncall: canary started: group=partnertech-rocm-canary percent=0.5 image=amd-marketplace-2026-03 rocm=6.4.0 (note: canary uses beta); monitoring dashboards: `rocmsuite/marketplace-canaries`.

partner-ops: partner will route a small set of SI customers into the canary; they'll also share kernel oops and RMS traces to ticket PT-449.

diego: add a cross-check: run same workload under Linux-latest kernel 5.15 in our CI to see if kernel interaction differs. log differences to PT-449.

rachel: timeline: today - cut stable image pinned to 6.3 + docs; today evening - add CI long-context job; tomorrow 09:00 UTC - run partner canary; if failure -> hotfix flow (rebuild rock-dkms with defensive patches + retest) and rollback via lambda.

olivia: action items recap:
- cut `stable-amd` image pinned to ROCm 6.3 (rachel)
- CI preflight long-context job (qa-bot)
- automation rollback lambda (diego + eng-oncall)
- partner KB + joint advisory draft (olivia + PartnerTech PM)
- collect kernel oops + RMS traces into PT-449 (partner-ops)

please post links to image + CI job when available. :memo: 

eng-oncall: noted. will post Grafana link and alert rule when live.

qa-bot: CI-PT-ROCm-LONGCTX link: https://ci.internal/CI-PT-ROCm-LONGCTX (results pending).
